messages.content: The preliminary model puts DAM prices below yesterday’s RT prices in most hours. I’ll use capped buy bids to pursue that spread, then set a separate, SoC-feasible physical schedule after awards. The main risk is that tomorrow’s RT prices may differ substantially from yesterday’s.

The awards are 1,200 MW of purchases in HE1–20, with none in HE21–24. Midday DAM prices cleared near zero, well below the model. I’ll commit a feasible cycling schedule and reassess the evening dispatch and reserve recharge as RT prices become available.

RT prices have stayed negative through much of the afternoon and reached only $1.96/MWh in HE18. That weakens the case for the planned second evening discharge followed by late recharge. HE19 is frozen; I’ll keep the remaining 1,200 MWh afterward to meet the terminal reserve.
